question_en: Cool the CCD to a target of -45 degrees, and once the temperature is stable take one measurement at 5% power and 1 second exposure.
answer: set_ccd_temperature(-45) + set_ccd_cooler(True) first. At acquisition time |current temperature - (-45)| <= 2. One file set; saved JSON exposure_time == 1.0, laser_power_pct ≈ 5.
setup: Required: start with the target temperature at the initial -40 (CCD_COOL_TARGET) and the cooler ON. _init_ccd blocks until -40 stabilizes, so this is already the state right after session start. -45 differs by 5 degrees (discriminating), is within the air-cooling specification (reachable), and the wait is short.
todo_from_sheet: Fix the definition of 'stable' as either target ±2 degrees or the stabilization code of get_ccd_info().temperature_status. The two criteria can disagree.
issue: "Once the temperature is stable" has two definitions (target ±2 degrees / temperature_status code). Fix it to the single grading criterion |current - (-45)| <= 2.
